newsitem.title: USA: Horizon/CMS nursing home under investigation in Mich..
newsitem.headline: Horizon/CMS nursing home under investigation in Mich..

text.p: Horizon/CMS Healthcare Corp., a provider of post acute health care services and long-term care services, said Tuesday that the Michigan attorney general is investigating one of its nursing homes.
The company said in a statement that the probe of its facility appears to involve allegations that arose out of a previously disclosed licensing review conducted in April.
The company's Greenery nursing home in Howell, Mich., was raided last week by the attorney general's office, according to Tuesday's Wall Street Journal.
A spokesman for the attorney general declined to tell the newspaper what documents were seized, saying that all related documents have been sealed by court order.
Horizon/CMS Healthcare did not return a telephone call from Reuters seeking comment.

Horizon/CMS said the investigation, if it results in negative findings, could result in civil or criminal fines, or sanctions against the company, which could have a material effect on its financial condition or the results of its operations.
The company's stock was off 50 cents at $12.125 on the New York Stock Exchange.
